'''Patrick Dinelle''' (also known as '''Pat Dinelle'''; forum handle '''PatThePotato''') was a [[Shadow Squadron]] member (Shadow 40) of the [[Players Committee]], listed at Montreal, Quebec on the 23 April 2003 roster.<ref name="vol20030423">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423194826/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 23 April 2003)</ref> He was the tournament director of the [[2003 Quebec Provincial Championship]] (13 April 2003, University of Quebec, Montreal).<ref name="pc-intl03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040621085705/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> On 18 April 2003 the Players Committee retroactively disqualified him from that event, forfeiting all his prizes, including the title of Champion, the bye into Day 2 of the World Championships and the uncut sheet; [[Raphael Asselin]] was declared 2003 Quebec Provincial Champion.<ref name="pc-quebecruling">[http://swccgpc.com/News/quebecruling04182003.htm Championship Circuit Committee's Official Ruling on Quebec Provincial], swccgpc.com (18 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030612201254/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/quebecruling04182003.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-apr03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/april03archives.htm April Updates], swccgpc.com (18 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

He played at the [[2001 Montreal DPC]] on 18 August 2001 with Brangus, according to Eric George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2879">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-21-montreal-18-08-01d2879/ montreal-18-08-01], DeckTech (Eric "Inspecta_Dek" George, 21 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-21-montreal-18-08-01d2879/ GitHub Pages].</ref> In 2004 he posted on the [[Players Committee]] forum as PatThePotato, signing as Patrick Dinelle, and played with the Montreal Crew.<ref name="pcf-4007-55194">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55194#55194 My VC (Mike R.)], Patrick Dinelle (PatThePotato), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041031174412/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55156%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-4035-55547">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55547#55547 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Nov. 7], Patrick Dinelle (PatThePotato), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041104184026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55278%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
